headline: Extortion at the highest level
dek: Democrats are threatening officials with impeachment and donors with prison, without reason, the President says; he orders the Department of Justice to look into it.

original.speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: The Democrats are going around threatening a lot of people, including the Attorney General of the United States, and others, with Impeachment and many other forms of punishment, even though they admit they have no reason to do so, and there have been no impeachable acts committed, or even thought of, by the victims of this illegal process. This is extortion at the highest level, and they should be held accountable for this. Also, they’re threatening our Donors, some of the most respected people anywhere in the World, with imprisonment, and many other levels of punishment, just because they happen to be Republicans, or Republican supporters. This is Weaponization and Lawfare at another level. The Senator from Michigan, Elissa Slotkin, is saying that she is going to go after all young people that believe in Republican Values, and that give even the slightest inclination to be a Republican. The imprisonment should be against these EXTORTIONISTS, and Republicans should get smart, fast! Threatening letters have been sent to many people, all innocent, from Democrat Political Leaders. By copy of this statement, I am ordering the Department of Justice to look into this criminal act, immediately! President DONALD J. TRUMP

verification.note: Copied by the editor from truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump on 7 November 2026. Time approximate: shown as 9:45 AM in the editor’s time zone (Pacific), i.e. 12:45 PM ET.

en: Several members of my administration, including the Attorney General, have been threatened with impeachment, and some Republican supporters say they have received letters warning them of legal consequences. I believe these threats are unjustified, and I am concerned that political disagreements are being turned into legal threats.

Impeachment is a serious constitutional process, reserved for serious misconduct, and it should never be used as a means of pressure. Anyone who believes they are being threatened unlawfully should contact law enforcement. It will be for the Department of Justice, acting independently, to determine whether any law was broken. I ask the leaders of both parties to lower the temperature.
fr: Plusieurs membres de mon administration, dont le procureur général des États-Unis, ont été menacés de destitution, et des sympathisants républicains disent avoir reçu des lettres les avertissant de conséquences judiciaires. Je considère ces menaces comme injustifiées, et je m’inquiète de voir des désaccords politiques se transformer en menaces judiciaires.

La destitution est une procédure constitutionnelle grave, réservée à des fautes graves ; elle ne doit jamais servir de moyen de pression. Quiconque s’estime menacé illégalement doit s’adresser aux forces de l’ordre. Il appartiendra au ministère de la Justice, agissant en toute indépendance, de déterminer si la loi a été enfreinte. J’appelle les dirigeants des deux partis à apaiser le ton.

text: Bon. Il dit qu’on menace ses amis de destitution sans raison, et que c’est de l’extorsion « au plus haut niveau ». Chez nous, le plus haut niveau, ce sont les Diablerets, et on y monte à pied, sans menacer personne.
Qui a raison ? Faut voir. Mais crier « en prison » à tout bout de champ, ça joue pas trop, ou bien ?
en: Well. He says his friends are being threatened with impeachment for no reason, and that it’s extortion “at the highest level”. Round here, the highest level is the top of the Diablerets, and we walk up there without threatening anyone.
Who’s right? We’ll see. But shouting “to jail” at every turn doesn’t really work, does it?
notes: Les Diablerets (3,210 m) is the highest summit of the canton of Vaud.

text: Il dit que ses adversaires menacent tout le monde de destitution, alors qu’il n’y aurait rien à reprocher à personne.

Ici, quand on soupçonne une montre de mal fonctionner, on ne crie pas au sabotage : on l’ouvre, on regarde, et on laisse l’horloger trancher. Les procès, c’est pareil. On laisse le juge ouvrir le boîtier.
en: He says his opponents are threatening everyone with impeachment, when nobody has done anything wrong.
Round here, when we suspect a watch isn’t working, we don’t cry sabotage: we open it, we look, and we let the watchmaker decide. Trials are the same. Let the judge open the case.

text: Salut les gaillards ! Il dit qu’on menace ses amis et ses donateurs, et que c’est de l’extorsion.

Chez nous, à Fribourg, on a deux langues et on s’entend quand même. Quand ça chauffe, on ne crie pas « en prison » : on fait une fondue moitié-moitié. Moitié pour toi, moitié pour moi. Ça calme tout le monde.
en: Hey folks! He says his friends and donors are being threatened, and that it’s extortion.
In Fribourg we speak two languages and still get along. When things heat up, we don’t shout “to jail”: we make a half-and-half fondue. Half for you, half for me. It calms everyone down.

text: Il dit qu’on menace ses amis, que c’est de l’extorsion, et que la prison, c’est pour les autres. Bon.
Ici, on dit qu’il ne faut pas crier contre le vent : ça vous revient dans la figure. Envoyez donc les lettres à la justice, et laissez-la faire son travail. Elle aussi, elle aime le calme.
en: He says his friends are being threatened, that it’s extortion, and that prison is for the other side. Right.
Here we say you shouldn’t shout into the wind: it comes straight back in your face. Send the letters to the courts, and let them do their job. They like a bit of calm too.

text: « De l’extorsion au plus haut niveau », « du lawfare à un autre niveau »… Il aime bien les niveaux. Moi aussi : j’habite au sixième sans ascenseur.
Bref, si quelqu’un menace quelqu’un, il y a des juges pour ça. Ordonner une enquête au ministère de la Justice par communiqué, c’est très pratique. Pas sûr que ce soit très indépendant.
en: “Extortion at the highest level”, “lawfare at another level”… He likes his levels. So do I: I live on the sixth floor, no lift.
Anyway, if someone threatens someone, there are judges for that. Ordering the Justice Department to investigate by press release is very convenient. Not sure it’s very independent.

text: Oh, quelle histoire ! On menace ses donateurs, des gens parmi les plus respectés du monde entier, de l’univers même ! Et la destitution, et la prison, et tout !
Moi je dis : du calme. Ici, quand deux voisins se disputent pour une boule de pétanque, avant de crier, on mesure.
en: Oh, what a to-do! They’re threatening his donors, some of the most respected people in the whole world, in the universe even! And impeachment, and prison, and everything!
I say: calm down. Round here, when two neighbours argue over a pétanque ball, before anyone shouts, we measure.
